meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 作为主持人,将各个 Git 工作区/分支/PR 当作参会者,在共享聊天文件里轮流发言、讨论冲突,最后亲自产出整合计划(目标工作区、合并顺序、冲突解法)。全程只读,不实际合并。
howto.when: 当用户要求对比并整合多个 Git 工作区、分支或 PR 的改动时,技能就会启动;例如直接说“开个站会”或“整理合并方案”。

say.text: 帮我把这几个分支开个站会,输出一份整合计划。
say.note: 创建一个共享聊天室,让各分支轮流发言。

say.text: 对比我所有工作区、分支和打开的 PR,给出合并顺序。
say.note: 会先列出候选清单供你确认。

say.text: 让这两个分支的改动做一次只读协商,别真合并。
say.note: 只产出计划,真正的合并交给 /do。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as facilitator: worktrees/branches/PRs are participants in a shared chat file; they introduce changes, resolve conflicts through rounds, and Claude writes a final consolidation plan (target, order, resolutions). Read-only, no merging.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to compare and consolidate changes across multiple git worktrees, branches, or PRs (e.g., 'run a standup' or 'plan a merge').

say_en.text: Run a standup over these branches and give me one merge plan.
say_en.note: Creates a shared chat where branch agents speak.

say_en.text: Compare all my worktrees, branches, and open PRs, then propose an order.
Let these two branches negotiate read-only; don't actually merge.
say_en.note: Outputs a SUMMATION; real merges go through /do.
